extracted.intended_audience: aspiring stand-up comedians (beginners to early intermediate) looking to learn joke writing and perform a short routine
extracted.subtask_description: A five-week beginner-level stand-up comedy course teaching joke-writing (setups, punchlines, tags), stage presence, and how to prepare and perform a polished 3–5 minute routine, delivered in-person or live via Zoom.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write original setups, punchlines, and tags using the Joke Prospector
rubrics_metrics.description: Write original setups, punchlines, and tags using Greg Dean’s Joke Prospector Writing System — the only method that takes you from a blank page to a complete, audience-ready joke.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is presented as the core writing system taught in the course; emphasis on taking material from blank page to audience-ready joke.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write setups that spark the audience’s imagination
rubrics_metrics.description: How to write setups that spark the audience’s imagination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on crafting the lead-in that places the audience in the right mental frame for the punchline; taught in class as a discrete skill.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write punchlines that surprise and make them laugh
rubrics_metrics.description: How to write punchlines that surprise and make them laugh.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on surprise and comedic payoff; punchline construction taught as a central metric of joke quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add tags to extend the laughter
rubrics_metrics.description: How to add tags to extend the laughter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teaching how to append short additional lines (tags) after a punchline to sustain or build on laughs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create multiple joke formats (one-liners, observational, political, storytelling)
rubrics_metrics.description: How to create one-liners, observational jokes, political jokes, and funny storytelling routines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course covers a range of joke types so students can develop diverse material and approaches to writing and performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perform a polished 3–5 minute stand-up routine
rubrics_metrics.description: How to perform a polished 3–5 minute stand-up routine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final performance goal for the class; includes shaping material into a cohesive short set suitable for open mics and clubs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gain confidence in front of any audience
rubrics_metrics.description: How to gain confidence in front of any audience, from open mics to comedy clubs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training addresses mindset and practical performance skills so students can present material comfortably in varied live settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop stage presence
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn setups, punchlines, tags, stage presence, and so much more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stage presence is taught alongside writing and delivery; in-person classes emphasize venue context and physical performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Receive direct feedback and coaching
rubrics_metrics.description: Receive direct feedback from Greg Dean or certified coaches (in-person) / interactive classes with live feedback and coaching (Zoom).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both formats promise live, actionable feedback; in-person offers venue-specific coaching, Zoom provides interactive critique with the same curriculum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow a step-by-step system rather than 'just get up and try'
rubrics_metrics.description: This isn’t a “just get up and try” class — it’s a step-by-step system that teaches you the craft of stand-up comedy from the ground up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes structured, progressive instruction (the Greg Dean Method) as the preferred learning approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attend classes, complete homework, and review missed class recordings promptly
rubrics_metrics.description: If you cannot make a class, contact us on slack to get the recording of the class. Make certain you go through the entire recording before the next class. Homework assignments are assigned in some classes, please be certain to do all homework when assigned before the next class.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation, timely completion of homework, and watching recordings before the following session are treated as course requirements for keeping up with the curriculum.
